All the refinements work. Refresh http://maker:4001/edge-save.html and let's confirm the three you shaped.

**1. Long text now shortens with expand.** Look at the top "A Comprehensive, Exhaustive…" item: the title and description are now **cut off with a clamp** and a **"Show more"** link appears — click it to expand, "Show less" to collapse. The ten tags **wrap onto extra lines** as you wanted. Does that keep the list scannable while letting you see everything on demand?

**2. Duplicate takes you to the existing item, ready to edit.** Type `css-tricks.com/snippets/css/complete-guide-grid` (already saved) and Save. Click **"Show the one you saved"** — it jumps to that bookmark and **opens it with editable Title and Description fields** (tags and note are editable right there too). Change the title, press **Done**. Is that the "take me there so I can update it" behavior you meant?

**3. A page with no readable details saves, then invites you to fill it in.** Type `nometa.example/page` (wired to simulate unreadable details) and Save. → It saves and **immediately shows empty "Add a title" / "Add a description" fields** so you can enter them yourself. Fill them in and press Done.

Also note: **every bookmark now has an "✎ edit" control** next to its title, so you can revise the title and description of any item later, not just these edge cases.

Do these three match what you asked for?
